apis.name: Azure DevOps REST API
apis.why_notable: Microsoft’s full DevOps platform API: repos, pipelines, boards, artifacts, and work items for cloud and on-prem Azure DevOps.

apis.name: Buildkite API
apis.why_notable: Pipeline-as-code CI with agent fleets; REST API for pipelines, builds, agents, and test analytics.

apis.name: CloudBees CodeShip API
apis.why_notable: CloudBees-hosted CI; project and build management via REST for teams still on CodeShip Pro/Basic.

apis.name: CodeClimate Quality API
apis.why_notable: Automated code review and maintainability metrics; org/repo analysis status and test coverage via API.

apis.name: Coveralls API
apis.why_notable: Coverage reporting service with REST for jobs, repos, and badge data; widely used with open-source CI.

apis.name: Cypress Cloud API
apis.why_notable: Cypress Dashboard/Cloud HTTP API for runs, specs, and test results from E2E browser test suites.

apis.name: Gitea API
apis.why_notable: Self-hostable Git forge (Go); OpenAPI for repos, issues, PRs, and orgs—GitHub-like surface without GitHub lock-in.

apis.name: Gitee Open API
apis.why_notable: Major China-focused Git hosting; v5 REST for repos, issues, PRs, and enterprises—regional alternative to GitHub.

apis.name: Honeycomb API
apis.why_notable: Observability platform API for datasets, queries, triggers, and SLOs; strong OpenTelemetry / high-cardinality focus.

apis.name: Hugging Face Hub API
apis.why_notable: ML model/dataset/space registry REST; the de facto package hub for open AI artifacts and git-backed repos.

apis.name: JetBrains Space API
apis.why_notable: JetBrains all-in-one DevOps (git, CI, issues, packages); HTTP API for automation across Space projects.

apis.name: LambdaTest Automation API
apis.why_notable: Cross-browser/device cloud testing competitor to BrowserStack/Sauce; REST for sessions, tunnels, and smart UI.

apis.name: NuGet Gallery API
apis.why_notable: Official .NET package protocol (v3): search, metadata, package content—primary registry for NuGet packages.

apis.name: Pulumi Cloud API
apis.why_notable: IaC state and org management REST for stacks, updates, and deployments—Terraform Cloud alternative in code.

apis.name: Render API
apis.why_notable: PaaS deploy platform with full REST for services, deploys, jobs, and databases—popular Git-to-prod path.

apis.name: Semaphore CI API
apis.why_notable: Fast CI/CD with API for projects, pipelines, promotions, and secrets; strong for monorepos and promotions.

apis.name: Snyk API
apis.why_notable: Developer security platform API for SCA, container, IaC, and code scans; org projects and issues via REST.

apis.name: Vercel API
apis.why_notable: Frontend cloud REST for deployments, projects, domains, and env vars—default Git deploy surface for Next.js.

apis.name: Woodpecker CI API
apis.why_notable: Lightweight open-source CI (Drone fork lineage); HTTP API for repos, pipelines, and secrets on self-hosted instances.

apis.name: codeberg / Forgejo API
apis.why_notable: Forgejo-powered free Git hosting (Codeberg); Swagger REST for repos and issues—FOSS community alternative to GitHub.

apis.name: pkg.go.dev / proxy.golang.org
apis.why_notable: Official Go module proxy and sumdb endpoints used by every `go` toolchain install—package registry for Go.

apis.name: Chromatic GraphQL API
apis.why_notable: Visual regression / Storybook cloud; GraphQL for builds, tests, and review state in UI component CI.

apis.name: Checkly API
apis.why_notable: API & browser synthetic monitoring as code; REST for checks, groups, and alerting—dev-centric alternative to legacy APM.

apis.name: Netlify API
apis.why_notable: Jamstack hosting REST for sites, deploys, forms, and edge functions—long-standing Git-based deploy platform.

apis.name: deps.dev API
apis.why_notable: Google Open Source Insights public API: package versions, advisories, and dependency graphs across ecosystems.
